Messages.Author: Brewski
Messages.Body: How can rescue a vampire in torpor and diablerize not be a direct action?

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
> Brewski wrote:
> How can rescue a vampire in torpor and diablerize not be a direct action?
>
They are direct actions of they target another Methuselah (and you control the acting vampire), but they are undirected actions if one of your vampires attempts to target another vampire you control with such actions.

V:EKN Website Coordinator
